definitions_and_constructions.scope: The manuscript contains one numbered Definition (2.1). Main surrounding constructions are mapped separately below. Additional modified-family constructions are recorded with their numbered theorem rows; listing a definition does not certify its analytic/arithmetic claims.

items.label: Order-s rational moment functional
items.constructed_scope: The printed Bernoulli monomial moments and harmonic simple-pole moments are defined over Q; arbitrary polynomial plus finite simple-pole normal forms have an explicit polynomial-valued mu. Representation uniqueness and the exact algebraic rational-function domain are new compiled and independently axiom-audited constructions.
items.remaining_obligation: Lift mu and tau as linear maps on their RatFunc subspaces and assemble their substitution identities. Defined moment values do not themselves prove linear-functional domain identification or analytic realization.

items.label: Parameters, denominators and quotient/residue data
items.constructed_scope: Actual k,m,N,K, weight 2k+1, h=K-N, admissibility, D_N, tail denominator, polynomial quotient and residues are explicit.
items.remaining_obligation: No extra arithmetic/asymptotic theorem follows from these definitions.

items.label: Harmonic sums and true zeta center
items.constructed_scope: The rational harmonic sums and convergent positive real zeta series are defined; the series is identified with the real part of Mathlib riemannZeta.
items.remaining_obligation: The identification supplies no irrationality statement.

items.label: Tau functional and its simple integer-pole domain
items.constructed_scope: Bernoulli tau monomial/pole generators and finite-span tau are explicit; the new TauDomain is exactly the rational functions whose denominator divides a finite product of distinct integer linear factors.
items.remaining_obligation: Lifted RatFunc linearity and actual substitution/reflection maps remain open; finite moment identities and representation independence are separate verified components under the current audit.

items.label: Actual affine pencil, determinant, Gram matrix and direction
items.constructed_scope: The residue-defined rational pencil, determinant delta, evaluated real Gram matrix and derivative matrix are actual definitions. The positive analytic moment realization is proved for admissible odd-weight parameters.
items.remaining_obligation: Later modified beta/multiweight families and their analytic measures must be constructed separately.

items.label: Primitive integer polynomial
items.constructed_scope: A nonzero rational determinant is normalized by clearing denominators, removing content and fixing a positive scale; an actual primitive Z-polynomial, degree and center positivity are proved.
items.remaining_obligation: The legacy rational-valued P_prim and the constructed integer polynomial are not counted as separate paper theorems. Quantitative integral multipliers/height bounds remain open.

items.constructed_scope: The actual whitening matrix is (sqrt G)^(-1) M (sqrt G)^(-1), with Euclidean operator norm. The new endpoint identifies the retained spectral-factor radius with inverse norm and transports to the actual primitive polynomial.
items.remaining_obligation: No missing definition or norm bridge for Theorem 3.1. Later exponential estimates remain open.

items.constructed_scope: The actual root vector, inverse-square atoms, finite moments, coalesced support/multiplicities and Hankel matrices are defined. Their finite-support positivity/rank laws are proved.
items.remaining_obligation: The corrected finite objects do not validate literal all-order strict positivity. Higher logarithmic-moment identification remains separately open.

items.constructed_scope: Actual rational dual constants, entries and determinant, with coefficient-Gram slope and its spectral theorem under row separation.
items.remaining_obligation: The continuous Beukers measures and infinite Krein subspaces/analytic identifications are not thereby constructed; see 5.1-5.3 and 6.7/6.17.
